strings: r_c tells m_c that the frostbite had simply progressed too far into {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} ear; {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} hearing is permanently damaged.

m_c concentrates, trying hard to hear the soft whispers of r_c, but it's barely audible to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} at all. r_c shakes {PRONOUN/r_c/poss} head and tells m_c in a louder voice that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} hearing was definitely damaged by the frostbite.
Ever since {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} ears were frostbitten, m_c has struggled to hear clearly.
